principle: Relations are typed and directional. A connection means the linked evidence addresses the relation; it does not imply universal causality.

mechanisms.label: Labile iron & iron homeostasis
mechanisms.description: Iron uptake, storage, release, compartmentalization and chelatable Fe²⁺.

mechanisms.label: PUFA phospholipid remodelling
mechanisms.description: Formation, transport and depletion of oxidizable membrane phospholipid substrates.

mechanisms.label: Lipid radical-chain oxidation
mechanisms.description: Initiation, propagation and termination of phospholipid peroxidation.

mechanisms.label: GPX4–glutathione defence
mechanisms.description: Selenium-dependent reduction of phospholipid hydroperoxides and its metabolic support.

mechanisms.label: FSP1–CoQ defence
mechanisms.description: GPX4-independent membrane radical control through quinone redox systems.

mechanisms.label: Organelle and membrane geography
mechanisms.description: Where oxidation, iron release and defence occur and how signals move between compartments.

mechanisms.label: Membrane failure and death execution
mechanisms.description: The transition from lipid damage to ion imbalance, rupture and population propagation.

mechanisms.label: Tumour state and microenvironment
mechanisms.description: How genotype, nutrients, oxygen, immunity and anatomical niche reshape sensitivity.

mechanisms.label: Tissue injury and organ protection
mechanisms.description: Ferroptosis-related damage in kidney, brain, grafts and other physiological contexts.

mechanisms.label: Chemical intervention and translation
mechanisms.description: Inducers, inhibitors, target engagement, exposure and treatment windows.

mechanisms.label: MUFA membrane remodelling defence
mechanisms.description: SCD1 desaturation, ACSL3 activation and MBOAT1/2 acyltransfer write monounsaturated fatty acids into membrane phospholipids, displacing oxidizable PUFA and raising the ferroptosis threshold independently of GPX4.

mechanisms.label: Selenium and selenoprotein supply
mechanisms.description: Cellular selenium uptake, transfer and utilization that supports synthesis of GPX4 and other selenoproteins.

mechanisms.label: Mitochondrial metabolic drive
mechanisms.description: A conditional, induction-specific mitochondrial contribution through glutaminolysis, the TCA cycle, the electron-transport chain and membrane potential.

mechanisms.label: Immune regulation of ferroptosis
mechanisms.description: How immune signalling, in particular CD8+ T-cell interferon-gamma, reshapes tumour-cell cystine metabolism and ferroptosis sensitivity during immunotherapy.

mechanisms.label: System xc- cystine supply
mechanisms.description: The cystine/glutamate antiporter (SLC7A11, xCT) that imports cystine for glutathione synthesis; its blockade by erastin is a founding trigger of ferroptosis.

mechanisms.label: GCH1-BH4 radical trapping
mechanisms.description: GTP cyclohydrolase 1 makes tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4), an endogenous radical-trapping antioxidant that raises the ferroptosis threshold independently of GPX4.

mechanisms.label: Mevalonate-sterol antioxidants
mechanisms.description: The mevalonate pathway supplies CoQ10 and sterol intermediates such as 7-dehydrocholesterol that suppress phospholipid peroxidation.

mechanisms.label: ACSL4–LPCAT3 PUFA esterification
mechanisms.description: The acyl-CoA synthetase and lysophospholipid acyltransferase step that activates arachidonoyl and adrenoyl chains and esterifies them into membrane phospholipids, setting how much oxidizable substrate the membrane carries.
